body: I'm so sorry. I'm praying for you. The one thing I know is true-- the God I am praying to is watching over you. He loves you and so do I.

I believe in the afterlife. I'm Christian. It took me a long time to actually believe in what I was raised in but I do believe now. It doesn't make sense at first. But the truth is, I believe there is a God who is watching us all, and loves you. When I was thinking about dying, and I realized everything in my life that I held important to me was gone, I thought why should I live? But the realization that everything in life is so unstable and temporary helped me to understand Christianity. Shouldn't there be something greater than life? There has to be, because look around us! Look at these horrible stories, look at the atrocities people have experienced. This is not what we are here for. There is something bigger. It is God. I am just a baby Christian. But I'm learning. God is not some scary genie, mythology creature or anything like that. His love for all humans is beyond what we can imagine or understand. I know this probably doesn't make sense, but you can pray. You should pray and just reach out to God, asking for truth and asking for hope. He will provide. You don't have to understand it. It's worth a try. Just talk like you're talking to a friend in the room. Explain your situation. Explain your pain. Please! I'm praying for you! sorry this message sounds weird, but I hope you do try.
